source.execution_source: Both jobs check out the same dispatched committed Git revision containing this plan. Source revision binds preparation, independent Windows reader verification, DAO and Rust snapshots and coverage receipts; same-run artifact names include that revision. Input pins bind meaningful workflow, fixture, update, reader and evaluator code.

authorization: The user authorized DAO experiments and mutations. Independently review and commit this plan before one workflow_dispatch with run_acquisition=true and its exact SHA-256. Root dispatches after reviewed tooling merges. No provider installation or license acceptance.
question: Do the three exact public field-update requests preserve all other file bytes and full unrelated semantics when both original and updated files are read by hosted stock x86 DAO and Rust?

inventory.contract: Separate update inventory. Each Items table has 33 declared rows with Id/Value Long, 200-byte Text payloads and 4-byte Binary payloads. Notes preserves 2048-byte Memo and null rows. The third case also has an earlier Prefix table. Exact typed recipes and request tuples reside in the pinned inventory.

inputs.plan_sha256: SHA-256 of these exact committed plan bytes

execution.producer: Ubuntu builds locked jet3-update-fixture and jet3-cli. Create before images via public create_database_with_table_rows, copy to after images and apply exactly one public update_field per scenario. Preserve both files. Independently verify declared table/column/physical cursor row and previous Long through public reader, derive its contained field slice and require a unique raw-row match on the reported data page. Reject any difference outside the four-byte field and require requested replacement bytes. Snapshot both full files, assert exact before/after recipes and unchanged image hashes. Retain preparation, receipts and logs.
execution.consumer: Windows2022 downloads exact same-run generated artifacts and builds Rust reader/checker. Re-derive requested field/range and all-byte preservation independently from retained before/after images; require the complete receipt to equal the Unix receipt. Snapshot both files with Rust. Stock probe must report dao_environment protocol 1.2.0, ready, x86, DAO.DBEngine.36 and dbVersion30. DAO producer enforces that contract, retains exact environment bytes and binds their SHA in its manifest, then opens all six images read-only and captures full snapshots with before/after hashes.
execution.comparison: Require complete ordered three-case preparation and six-image DAO inventory, matching source/platform/verifier receipts and retained environment identity/contract. Validate canonical snapshots and separate coverage receipts, all image identities, exact complete expected schemas/rows/payloads before and after, and DAO/Rust projections. Independently check requested field bytes and byte-for-byte equality everywhere else using the rederived range. Matching producers alone cannot substitute for the declared request. No index probes are required because every declared table is unindexed; full schema snapshots assert empty indexes and relationships.
execution.helpers: Load only named snapshot-helper ASTs from the pinned original read producer, never execute its acquisition. Existing read and write contracts/consumed plans remain unchanged.
execution.limits: Three fixed requests only. Generation/snapshot subprocess timeout 120 seconds, Ubuntu job 20 minutes, Windows job 30 minutes; retain partial failures. No automatic retry or altered case/control after acquisition.

decision_rule.matched: All three before/after pairs generated, all six read-only DAO/Rust snapshots satisfy full requests and identities, exact ready provider evidence retained, independent Windows verifier agrees and all unrelated bytes preserved. matched applies only to this finite hosted inventory; report support_matrix_movement remains false.
decision_rule.no_outcome: Any missing/provider/identity/source/verification/recipe/capture/coverage or semantic failure prevents matched. Evaluation failure retains report.json no_outcome; earlier failure retains available preparation/provider/workflow diagnostics without inventing an evaluation report.
decision_rule.retry: Only GitHub run attempt 1; no rerun or redispatch of this consumed plan. A failure after provider probe or other first DAO mutation is a scientific result. Preserve it; any successor requires a distinct reviewed plan under standing user authorization.

retention.contents: Both original and updated MDBs for every case; preparation.json, exact environment.json, DAO manifest and hash, independent verification logs/reader.json, raw/canonical DAO and Rust snapshots, coverage, report when reached, and complete job/stdout/stderr failure logs. Never commit MDB/provider binaries.
retention.outcome: One additive EXP-0160 from validated retained JSON. Original hosted creation no_outcome and all local outcomes remain unchanged.

coverage_limits: arbitrary concurrent writers or non-Unix publication
claims: No compatibility beyond these exact hosted cases, no completion of all #113 CRUD, no general atomic rollback outcome or automatic support-state promotion.
